description: Use this when you want data from another paid API without handling its invoice: pay ONE BitTuitive invoice (sats, or the same all-in price in USDC via x402) and BitTuitive pays the upstream, calls it and returns its JSON in `data` plus `routing` (upstream, score, fee). Pass endpoint_id (from list_routable_apis) or data_type and/or q for the best pick with automatic fallback. Cost: upstream price + routing fee max(20%, 3 sats). Side effect: spends your payment on the upstream call; if every upstream fails you get a 24h credit token to pass as `credit`. If the result is status 'running', repeat the identical call to collect it. Payment: call without a credential to get payment_required (isError=true) with a Lightning invoice, macaroon and x402 terms; pay it yourself (this server never pays), then repeat the identical call with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (single use, valid 10 min) or x402_payment. Bad input is rejected before any invoice. Example: call_routed_api(data_type="bitcoin", q="mempool fees")

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed routed call (instead of paying).

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

params.description: Optional query parameters forwarded to the upstream API.

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: call_routed_api
title: Call any verified data API through BitTuitive (sats or USDC)
